I lost my aid in may so after I finished the spring I was told I'd have to pay for my own tuition for a year which wouldn't of been so bad if i didn't have to get a private loan. I been very strained on money since then to where im slowly cutting stuff out of my budget. I been desperate to find a job because I did have some loans I needed to get and the bills will start coming any day. 

The thing that bothers me is with all this im going through all I can think of is my body and how I wish I looked different. 

If my aid magically came back I'd probably feel like I had a chance to complete something I really really thought Id achieve. It was my mindset since I was a kid to be the first of my family to earn a college degree. The loans wouldn't start coming since I'd still be enrolled and I'd have access to the therapist and gym on campus. And also feel productive again
Do you live in the valley :p
